comment: Shots for docs/media/kv-cli-demo-v2.gif, rendered by render_v2.py. A shot starts when its `after` text first appears on screen (plus `delay`), or, without `after`, where the previous shot ends, or at `at` seconds. While it lasts, its caption shows; with `focus`, the camera zooms to the lines that contain those texts; with `card`, a title card covers the terminal.

card.title: kv-cli
card.subtitle: Local contract guardrails for Python data pipelines

shots.caption: It checks pipeline code against your repository's contract
CI pins its fingerprint, so a pull request can't quietly weaken the rules
A pipeline job with a hardcoded password and a production S3 path
and a run_* job that doesn't take target_environment
kv-cli audit finds the credential, and never prints it
run_load must take target_environment, as the contract requires
Errors fail the gate: kv-cli exits 1
kv-cli fix adds both parameters and moves the password to os.environ
and says to rotate the credential: it is still in git history
The change is plain code, ready for review
The gate passes. The pinned S3 path stays a warning, yours to change
